name: カンバンの作業カード
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0004 カンバンの作業カード, a compact single task card.
Hierarchy: image1 ORIGINAL source controls icon glyphs, optical stroke weight, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Image2 our mock is SECONDARY Japanese text/layout, and its rough substitute icons or missing enclosures must not be copied. Image3 is approved white rounded surface/shadow style only. Never copy bus content.
Preserve source card information order and exact Japanese mock text: top-left small metadata「作業-12」, top-right original tiny assignee/person inside dotted circular perimeter. Second line small thin empty statuscircle then regular Japanese tasktitle「共有する要約を作成する」. Thirdline original circular white outlined prioritybutton containing three ascendingbars, followed by white neutral-outline categorypill with small amber/orange dot and「文書」. Bottomleft metadata「作成日 3月31日」.
Restore original priority circle missing from mock. Match original tiny dotted assignee geometry, avoid large sun/person cartoon. Empty statuscircle stays neutralgray, not a green check or filled in-progress marker.
Accents: original orange Documentation dot communicates a coherent category; retain subdued amber dot only in「文書」pill. All utilityicons #526173, no independent decorative icon colors. No primaryaction exists; do not invent green gradient button. The mock's green categorydot is a secondary adaptation, original categoryevidence controls this decision.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and card. Compact approx310x116 logicalpixel anatomy with suitable 12px roundedcorners, fine neutral border, soft downwardshadow, no nestedcards or oversizedpadding. Type Meiryo Regular14/24 body, Regular12/16 metadata, zero tracking; title not bold. Preserve proportional type and one-line tasktitle. Render a tightly framed standalone horizontal card with minimal outerwhitepadding, not an entire kanban board. No added title, metrics, actions, other cards or English text. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: 全原画像・個別切抜き・通常/390幅モックを実見。日本語作業12/共有する要約を作成する/文書/作成日3月31日、未着手円、担当者、優先度円を確認。原画像の優先度円を復元し文書分類の琥珀点を一貫した分類色として採用、補助はスレート。白面・細境界・控えめな影。精密な原ベクター同一性と書体バイナリは未証明。エージェント目視確認のみで、所有者承認・新規ネイティブ編集可能化・アプリ実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
